claims.text: Let \(A_m=H^\star(GL_{4m}/B,\mathbb Z)\), \(v_m=v_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\), and let \(w_m=w_{2m,2m,m+1,4m}\). Then \[ J_{v_m}^{A_m}=I_{w_m}^{A_m},\qquad \mu_{A_m}(J_{v_m}^{A_m})=\mu_{A_m}(I_{w_m}^{A_m}). \] Indeed \(m+1\le2m\) and \(m+1>0=2m+2m-4m\), so \(v_m\) is an admissible bigrassmannian. The dissector property gives \[ S_{4m}=\{u:u\ge v_m\}\sqcup\{u:u\le w_m\}, \] hence \(u\ge v_m\iff u\not\le w_m\). Since integral Schubert classes are a homogeneous \(\mathbb Z\)-basis of \(A_m\), the defining spans of \(J_{v_m}^{A_m}\) and \(I_{w_m}^{A_m}\) are literally equal. Thus their homogeneous generating sets, and therefore their minimum cardinalities \(\mu_{A_m}\), coincide. [doi:10.1090/s0002-9947-2010-05163-3, lines 61-66]
